title: A Prayer in a Barren Valley

narration: What keeps a nation standing? An army? Or an economy?
The Quran's answer begins with one prayer.

lines.text: The answer begins with one prayer.

narration: Quran and Global Economy. Episode three: national security and economic prosperity, and the link between them.
Ibrahim, peace be upon him, settled his family in a barren valley.
Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in a valley without cultivation, near Your sacred House.

props.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّيٓ أَسۡكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيۡرِ ذِي زَرۡعٍ عِندَ بَيۡتِكَ ٱلۡمُحَرَّمِ
props.english: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House.

narration: And there he asked Allah for two things.
My Lord, make this a secure city, and provide its people with fruits.

props.arabic: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنٗا وَٱرۡزُقۡ أَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ
props.english: My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits.

narration: First: make this city secure. That is national security.
Second: provide its people with fruits. That is economic prosperity.

items.text: “Provide its people with fruits”: Economic Prosperity

narration: Where peace and prosperity meet, the state survives.
Without an economy, security cannot stand. The system collapses.
And without security, the economy cannot stand. Investments and assets are not safe.

items.text: Without economy, security: the system cannot stand
Without security, economy: investment and assets are not safe

narration: Makkah became a global trade pipeline, and a rest stop on the highway of trade.
And the Quran formally recognised this economic route, in Surah Quraysh.
For the security of Quraysh: their security in the caravans of winter and summer.

props.arabic: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ ۝ إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ
props.english: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh: their accustomed security in the caravan of winter and summer.
props.highlight: the caravan of winter and summer

narration: So let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them against hunger, and made them safe from fear.

props.arabic: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ ۝ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
props.english: Let them worship the Lord of this House, who has fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.
props.highlight: fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear
